result.title: Freeforward4d: Annotation-free feed-forward 4d reconstruction of driving scenes
result.summary: Feed-forward 4D reconstruction enables efficient creation of renderable driving scenes for autonomous driving simulation. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dataset-provided cameras, LiDAR depth, or 3D box annotations, limiting their applicability to unannotated driving videos. Pretrained visual models can predict cameras, depth, and object tracks from RGB alone, but their geometry is mutually inconsistent: multi-view predictions come in short windows with independent scales and frames, while monocular depth is metric only per image. Our key insight is that, once reconciled into a single metric frame, these priors can replace dataset annotations for feed-forward 4D reconstruction. We present \textbf{FreeForward4D}, which calibrates overlapping prediction windows against monocular metric depth and registers them into one frame across time. On this geometry, 2D tracks are associated across cameras in 3D, and objects move through hierarchical motion that combines a shared object velocity with local Gaussian corrections, so that both training and inference use only RGB videos. On Waymo, FreeForward4D achieves 27.66 dB PSNR and 0.836 SSIM while recovering metric-scale cameras and depth without scale alignment. It surpasses STORM, SLARM-F, UFO, DGGT, and StreetForward, which rely on dataset annotations, in full-image PSNR and attains the best RGB fidelity on 8-second windows. RGB-only fine-tuning further adapts the framework to nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FreeForward4D，实现无标注的前馈 4D 驾驶场景重建：把尺度与坐标系彼此不一致的多视角短窗预测与单目度量深度对齐，配准到同一度量坐标系，并在该几何上完成跨相机 3D 轨迹关联与「共享物体速度＋局部高斯修正」的分层运动建模，训练与推理仅用 RGB 视频。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把冲突的视觉先验校准到统一参考系、以及「全局共享分量＋局部修正」的状态更新结构，可能为 LVR 中融合异构视觉证据、设计分层 latent 状态更新提供类比线索，但需核查其是否仅为重建管线而无推理层面的对应。
